category.name: Transcription & Meeting Notes
category.description: Turn recorded or live speech into text; meeting services add capture, summaries and collaboration, while open engines provide a lower-level alternative.
category.audience: People documenting meetings, interviews and recordings; developers building private speech-to-text workflows.
category.audienceRationale: Speech-to-text supports recurring meetings and recorded content across roles; engine deployment requires technical integration.

pricing.note: Pro standard USD price per user/month billed annually; monthly standard $16.99. Conditional regional promotions excluded.
Pro USD price per seat/month billed annually; monthly $18. Free plan exists; additional AI usage subject to credits/rate limits.

oss.name: Whisper
oss.classificationReason: Tier A for the published speech recognition code and model weights, explicitly MIT in README. Local CLI/Python workflow has no documented paid edition gate. A developer engine, not a meeting-notes workspace. May be run locally or embedded in a self-operated service.
serviceLimitations: Local inference requires user-provided compute and setup.
Optional first-party whisper-1 API is separate hosted usage; current documentation marks it deprecated, available to existing integrations until 2027-02-26.

health.rsx: Central authenticated rsx analyze: 6.2/10; balanced policy passed. Proxy metrics not treated as verified maintenance facts.

oss.name: Vosk
oss.classificationReason: Tier A for Vosk API plus an Apache-2.0 model such as vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15. Offline library with streaming and speaker-identification primitives; not a meeting-notes application. Model catalog licenses vary, including noncommercial choices; API license does not cover every model.
serviceLimitations: User supplies runtime hardware and integration.
No first-party managed hosting offer verified in reviewed official documentation.
Select models individually: some French/Dutch catalog entries use noncommercial licenses and are outside this scoped OSS recommendation.

health.rsx: Central authenticated rsx analyze: 5.6/10; balanced policy passed. Proxy metrics not treated as verified maintenance facts.

alternatives.migrationNotes: For teams replacing only audio-to-text: export or record audio separately and process with local CLI/Python. Build meeting capture, transcript UI, speaker diarization, summaries, search, sharing and integrations separately. No native incumbent workspace import or workflow parity verified.

For developers rebuilding only the transcription layer: supply recordings or audio streams and integrate the API/server. Speaker identification primitives exist; evaluate/build meeting diarization, capture, UI, summaries, storage, sharing and integrations. No native incumbent workspace import verified.

uncertainties: Only two scoped engines included; no complete deployable meeting-notes application verified in this focused review. Neither should be presented as a drop-in Otter or Fireflies replacement.
